items.difficulty_reason: Lower shriek and injectives for modules on slice sites: recalls f is continuous and cocontinuous with O_X = f^{-1}O_Y to get the left adjoint f_!^{Mod} (Modules on Sites, lower-shriek-modules), proves the slice-site equivalence X/x -> Y/f(x) of ringed sites, identifies f_! with the abelian-sheaf construction, and with equalizers plus faithfulness gets exactness of f_! (lemma-pullback-injective) so Homology, adjoint-preserve-injectives yields the injective-pullback claim. Retained author proof at lines 3066-3087.
